metadata.description: Skills, agents and MCP servers for Talentech: engineering, design, product and research.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Matt Pocock's engineering skills with Mimas's setup and review skills, plus tiered worker agents and a /orchestrate-spec orchestrator.

plugins.name: dev-progress
plugins.description: Mod: progress bar above the prompt and a live agents panel for /orchestrate-spec; shows any subagents, as crabs or JDM cars. Forked from savvy-progress.

plugins.name: crowdin-mcp
plugins.description: MCP: Crowdin's hosted MCP server for projects, strings, translations, glossaries and QA checks, signed in with your own account through OAuth.

plugins.name: productboard-mcp
plugins.description: MCP: Productboard's hosted MCP server for documents, features, initiatives, feedback and change history, signed in with your own account through OAuth.

plugins.name: talentech-core
plugins.description: Company-wide skills for every department: the grilling interview that role plugins wrap, grill-me, handoff, questionnaires, teach and wait-what, plus publishing to and pulling from Confluence (which needs the Atlassian connector).

plugins.name: talentech-design
plugins.description: Skills for Product Design: design briefs, design readiness, FigJam flows, a UX-flow grilling interview, wireframes, handoff pages for builders, Talentech UX content and translation.

plugins.name: talentech-product
plugins.description: Skills for Product Management: grill-prd takes a product idea from raw problem to a developer-ready PRD in two gated stages, on top of talentech-core's grilling.

plugins.name: talentech-research
plugins.description: UX research skills for design and product: research plans, method choice, interview guides, surveys, mixed methods, affinity synthesis, insight extraction, business cases, ethics and share-outs.
